summary: BUG-047 Addon Recipe CRUD fixes verified. All 4 sub-issues fixed and working: (1) Recipe Name auto-fills when selecting Linked Addon, (2) Payload includes preparation_time/serves_people/serve_time, (3) Ingredient keys are correct (id/qty/unit), (4) deleteAddonRecipe sends reason body. Full CRUD flow tested: Create, Read, Delete all working with success toasts.

addon_recipes_tab_loads.evidence: Addon Recipes tab accessible via Product Catalog page, data-testid='addon-recipe-catalogue' found

add_addon_recipe_button.evidence: data-testid='add-addon-recipe-btn' clickable, opens 'New Addon Recipe' form

recipe_name_auto_fill_BUG047_fix1.evidence: Selected '2 eggs boiled' addon, Recipe Name auto-filled with '2 eggs boiled' - Line 200-202 fix working

ingredient_selection_and_unit_auto_fill.evidence: Selected 'Abocus water (ltr)', unit auto-filled with 'ml', qty entered as 100

create_addon_recipe_BUG047_fix2_fix3.evidence: Recipe created successfully with toast 'Addon recipe created'. Payload includes preparation_time/serves_people/serve_time (fix2) and ingredient keys id/qty/unit (fix3)

recipe_appears_in_list.evidence: Created recipe '2 eggs boiled' with '1 ingredients' appeared in left panel list

view_recipe_detail.evidence: Clicked recipe card, detail view shows name '2 eggs boiled' and 1 ingredient row

delete_addon_recipe_BUG047_fix4.evidence: Delete button opens confirmation dialog, deletion successful with toast 'Addon recipe deleted'. API sends reason body (fix4)

recipe_removed_from_list.evidence: 'No addon recipes found' message displayed after deletion, Addons without recipe count back to 41

context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-047 Addon Recipe CRUD is fully fixed and working. The 4 sub-issues were: (1) Recipe Name auto-fill from Linked Addon - fixed in AddonRecipeCatalogue.jsx line 200-202, (2) Payload missing preparation_time/serves_people/serve_time - fixed in line 164-170, (3) Ingredient keys wrong - fixed to use id/qty/unit instead of ingredient_id/ingredient_qty/ingredient_unit, (4) deleteAddonRecipe missing reason body - fixed in api.js line 920-924. Note: The user abhishek@kalabahia.com mentioned in the review request has restaurant_type_flag='normal' which doesn't have access to Product Catalog (only 'master' type has access).
